 Follow Us On: News India BJP MP Kangana Ranaut congratulates newlyweds Omar Abdullah, Nidhi Razdan BJP MP Kangana Ranaut congratulates newlyweds Omar Abdullah, Nidhi Razdan
 Kangana Ranaut congratulated Omar Abdullah and Nidhi Razdan after they announced their marriage. The family-attended ceremony was solemnised under the Special Marriage Act in New Delhi.
 Advertisement Kangana Ranaut congratulated Omar Abdullah and Nidhi Razdan after they announced their marriage By: India Today News Desk New Delhi , Oct 31, 2026 19:40 IST Last Updated Oct 31, 2026 19:40 IST Published by Akshat Trivedi Oct 31, 2026 19:24 IST Written By Akshat Trivedi Bollywood Actor and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut has congratulated Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and television journalist Nidhi Razdan on their marriage.
 Taking to X on Saturday, Kangana shared a congratulatory message, writing, "Congratulations ". Congratulations— Kangana Ranaut (@KanganaTeam) October 31, 2026 
 Omar Abdullah announced his marriage to Nidhi on Saturday through a social media post, sharing four pictures of the couple. He wrote, "A new journey began yesterday..." and tagged Nidhi in the post.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Nidhi also confirmed the development through a post on X. Tagging Omar, she wrote, "It's done, bro".
 Sources said the couple solemnised their marriage under the Special Marriage Act in New Delhi on Friday. Family members from both sides attended the ceremony as witnesses.
 The wedding functions in Srinagar and New Delhi were attended by close relatives and family members from both sides.
 Omar's parents, National Conference president Farooq Abdullah and Mollie Abdullah, his three sisters and other close relatives attended the functions. Nidhi's parents, veteran journalist MK Razdan and Sarla Razdan, were also present.
 This is the second marriage for both. Omar, 56, was previously married to Payal, but the Supreme Court dissolved their marriage through an order in July this year after the two reached a settlement.
 Nidhi, 49, is also entering her second marriage. - Ends Advertisement Also Watch
